summary: KfW filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a $3 billion offering of 4.375% global notes due 2033. The notes are priced at 99.352% of par, with underwriting commissions of 0.15% and proceeds to KfW of 99.202%. The offering is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The notes are guaranteed by the Federal Republic of Germany, listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange, and settle on July 15, 2026. No event-driven or corporate action elements are present.
